content.text: Very common at this age, and it's fixable. Tonight, tell Milo the new rule at bedtime, while he's calm: "You sleep in your bed, and if you wake up, you can come check in with me and I'll walk you right back." Then every time he shows up, walk him back quietly and boringly, with no chat and no negotiating. Expect a few rough nights before it clicks, and it clicks faster if you do the same thing every single time.
